title: Will OpenAI Revenue Reset Stop AI Demand?
description: Bloomberg Intelligence's Mandeep Singh highlights that despite questions over OpenAI's revenue accounting, booming token growth indicates solid AI infrastructure demand. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Ex-Flipkart Execs Press Walmart to Buy Out Stock Options
description: A group of former Flipkart executives is urging parent Walmart Inc. to buy out their stock options, seeking to cash in while the US retailer weighs options including a separate listing for the India e-commerce operator.

title: Nvidia-Backed Firmus IPO Collapses as AI Valuation Concerns Grow
description: Firmus Grid Ltd. abandoned its attempt at one of Australia’s biggest-ever initial public offerings, after the Nvidia Corp.-backed data center company failed to lure global investors who’ve grown increasingly skittish over frothy AI valuations.
